decision.observation: 'UNIT CAPTURED' dialog: 'Allowing such a vulnerable unit to remain unprotected was not a wise choice. Your unit has been captured by Barbarians.' A lone Builder I moved east was captured by a barbarian. Dialog has OK button.
decision.hypothesis: Clicking OK dismisses the notification. I lost the unprotected Builder; keep future units escorted.
decision.memory: Builder lost to barbarians because it was undefended. Keep units protected.
